stories.title: Audit Code against Contracts
stories.story: As the project owner I want the Code reviewed against each Contract spec so that I know where the Code does not implement what the Contracts define.
acceptance: Every bus covered by the Contracts (CAN, SPI, HOST, TIME) is checked against the Code
Each Code divergence from a Contract is recorded as one row in the gap table
Each row states what the Contract specifies and what the Code does
The review lists gaps only and makes no fix recommendations

The review covers the STM32 firmware (Arm_Sensor_Hub/App and Arm_Sensor_Hub/Core), the Raspberry Pi host (RaspberryPi_Sensor_Hub) and the shared libraries (shared/libs); vendor code (Arm_Sensor_Hub/Drivers, Arm_Sensor_Hub/Middlewares) and build output are out of scope

stories.title: Audit Documentation against Contracts and Code
stories.story: As the project owner I want the Documentation reviewed against the Contracts and the Code so that I know where it describes either one inaccurately or leaves it out.
acceptance: Every bus covered by the Contracts (CAN, SPI, HOST, TIME) is checked against the Documentation
Each place the Documentation is silent on, or differs from, a Contract or the Code is recorded as one row in the gap table
Each row states what the Documentation says, or that it is silent
The review lists gaps only and makes no fix recommendations

stories.title: Write the gap report at Documentation/05_VERIFICATION/gaps.md
stories.story: As the project owner I want one structured gap report saved in the project so that it can be referenced in later sprints and used to plan alignment before physical testing of the buses between the sensors, STM32 and Raspberry Pi.
acceptance: The report exists at Documentation/05_VERIFICATION/gaps.md
The report is a table with the columns Contract spec, Code and Docs
Each row is one gap where the Contract, Code and Docs diverge
The report contains no fix recommendations and no priority order
The report covers the CAN, SPI, HOST and TIME buses

stories.title: Requester approves the gap report
stories.story: As the project owner I want to approve the gap report before the next sprint starts so that planning is based on gaps I have accepted.
acceptance: The requester has been given the finished gap report to review
The requester has recorded approval or requested changes
The next sprint is not started until the report is approved
